lore.creature: Hui Hai and Yă Hui Hai, the little forest folk
lore.from: Ba Na (Bahnar) folk belief, Central Highlands of Vietnam (Gia Lai, Kon Tum)
lore.title: The Hui Hai
lore.eyebrow: Ba Na folk belief · the Highland forest
story: Behave badly in the old forest of Vietnam's Central Highlands, and a small stone may land right beside you. Look around as much as you like. Nobody is there.

The Ba Na people, who live in these highlands, say the forests and the streams are home to the Hui Hai: a whole people so tiny that nobody can see them. The men are called Hui Hai, and the women Yă Hui Hai.
Being small does not make them weak. The Hui Hai are very strong. Anyone who behaves badly in their forest may hear a stone hit the ground at their feet, thrown by a hand nobody saw.
So walk gently among the ferns and by the streams. You will never see the Hui Hai. That doesn't mean they aren't there.
facts: The Ba Na of Vietnam's Central Highlands tell of the Hui Hai, invisible people of miniature size.
The men are called Hui Hai and the women Yă Hui Hai.
They live in the forests and the streams.
They are very small, but very strong.
They throw stones at people who behave badly in the forest. Nobody sees who threw it.

cards.name: A Pebble at Your Feet
cards.flavor: Behave badly in the forest, and a stone lands beside you. Nobody threw it.

cards.name: Hui Hai in the Ferns
cards.flavor: The fern moved. There was no wind.
cards.text: Tank. Taunt.

cards.name: Pebble-Thrower

cards.text: Assassin.

cards.name: Hui Hai at the Spring

cards.text: Tank. Once per round, after Hui Hai at the Spring survives damage, deal 1 damage to an enemy unit.

cards.name: Boulder-Pusher
cards.flavor: The boulder was on the path in the evening. In the morning it wasn't.
cards.text: Bruiser.

cards.name: Hui Hai in the Bamboo
cards.flavor: You hear the bamboo knock. You never see who knocked.
cards.text: Bruiser. Swift.

cards.name: Keeper of the Old Forest

cards.text: Tank. Fierce. Once per round, after Old One of the Waterfall survives damage, deal 2 damage to an enemy unit.

cards.name: Stones from Nowhere
cards.flavor: A whole hillside of pebbles, and not one hand to be seen.
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to each enemy unit.

cards.name: The Forest Remembers
cards.flavor: Cut a tree for nothing, and the forest will not forget your face.
cards.text: Deal 4 damage to an enemy unit.

cards.name: Nobody Threw It

cards.name: Grandfather Hui Hai, Mover of Rocks

cards.name: The Hidden Village
cards.flavor: A whole village lives in this clearing. You are standing in it.

cards.name: The Rock That Moved in the Night
cards.flavor: Everyone saw it on the hill. Nobody saw how it got there.
cards.text: Bruiser. Fierce.

cards.name: Small but Strong

cards.text: Ambush. A unit you control gets +2 Power this round.
